picks.headline: Machine learning methods move self-driving labs closer to materials discovery at scale
picks.excerpt: Washington University researchers trained models on 4,000 metal-organic framework linker transformations so the system 'reads chemistry like a chemist,' surfacing 10 new viable water-harvesting materials without brute-force screening. A parallel polymer effort automates data curation from the literature to rank high-potential candidates.
picks.rationale: 무차별 스크리닝 대신 화학 규칙을 학습시켜 후보를 좁히는 방식 — 자율 실험실 재료 탐색의 작업 순서를 바꾼다.

picks.headline: What's in Merck and Moderna's cancer vaccine algorithm?
picks.excerpt: STAT digs into the neoantigen-selection algorithm behind Merck and Moderna's individualized cancer vaccine, the model that decides which mutations each patient's shot targets. The details matter because the algorithm, not the chemistry, is the hard-to-copy asset.
picks.rationale: 개인 맞춤 암 백신의 진짜 자산이 화학이 아니라 항원 선택 알고리즘임을 뜯어본다 — AI가 임상 제품의 핵심이 된 사례.

picks.headline: GlucoFM: Foundation model for continuous glucose monitoring
picks.excerpt: Google Research introduces GlucoFM, a foundation model trained on continuous glucose monitor streams for forecasting and downstream metabolic tasks. It extends the sensor-foundation-model line from wearables into a dense clinical time-series domain.
picks.rationale: 웨어러블 파운데이션 모델 계보를 임상 시계열로 확장한 1차 발표 — 대사 연구의 예측 기준선이 바뀐다.

picks.headline: The Way You Draw Can Reveal Parkinson's Disease With Up to 99% Accuracy, Study Reveals
picks.excerpt: A machine-learning analysis of drawing and handwriting dynamics separated Parkinson's patients from controls with up to 99% accuracy. The signal sits in stroke timing and pressure rather than the finished image, making cheap tablet-based screening plausible.
picks.rationale: 완성된 그림이 아니라 획의 타이밍과 압력에 신호가 있다는 결과 — 태블릿만으로 되는 저비용 선별 검사를 연다.

picks.headline: Researchers Use IBM Quantum Computer to Test Drug-Docking Method
picks.excerpt: A team demonstrated a resource-efficient hybrid quantum-classical molecular docking method on an IBM quantum processor. The run is a concrete probe of where quantum hardware could slot into structure-based drug discovery pipelines.
picks.rationale: 양자 하드웨어가 구조 기반 신약 파이프라인 어디에 끼어들 수 있는지 실제 프로세서로 시험한 구체적 사례.
